item.title: Report: Court notification on reopening Mount Meron disaster investigation delayed by one month
item.description:
Police and prosecutors had planned to inform the Supreme Court on Thursday that the criminal investigation into the Mount Meron disaster would be reopened. However, the police legal adviser requested a one-month delay in submitting the notification, according to a report in Haaretz.
According to the report, the legal adviser, who is close to Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana, justified the request by citing the need to clarify certain matters with Police Commissioner Dani Levy.

item.title: Update: Three children, one adult killed in Oregon elementary school shooting
item.description: At least three children and one adult killed in a shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon. Suspect shot and killed.

item.title: IDF clarifies: Ramming near Ateret was not terror attack, driver transferred to security forces
item.description:
The IDF Spokesperson's Unit clarified, "Following the incident in the area of Ateret, an initial inquiry determined that the incident was not terror-related."
The driver was transferred to security forces, and officers from the Judea and Samaria District Police opened an investigation to establish the circumstances of the accident.

item.title: Several injured, including children, in shooting at Oregon elementary school
item.description: Several people, including children, injured in a shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon. Police say the gunman is dead and at least two were hospitalized.

item.title: Interceptor launched toward false target in southern Lebanon, no sirens sounded
item.description:
A short while ago, an interceptor was launched toward a false target identified in the area in which IDF soldiers are operating in southern Lebanon, the IDF Spokesperson's Unit said.
No sirens were sounded in accordance with protocol.
